mapper.sql: CASE t.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE t.compCode END
mapper.select: SELECT 'COMPANY' AS kind,TRIM(compCode) AS code,TRIM(compName) AS name, COALESCE(CAST(isDisabled AS UNSIGNED),0) AS status, CONCAT('',compID) AS source_id,NULL AS source_issue FROM ehr_company UNION ALL SELECT 'COMPANY',TRIM(),TRIM(t.compName), CASE CAST(t.state AS UNSIGNED) WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CONCAT('t_company:',t.id), CASE WHEN t.compCode IS NULL OR t.compCode NOT IN ('01','02','03','04') THEN 'COMPANY_ALIAS_UNMAPPED' END FROM t_company t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ehr_company e WHERE TRIM(e.compCode)=TRIM()) UNION ALL SELECT 'COMPANY',CASE code WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE code END,name, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 0 THEN 1 END,CONCAT('fnd_company:',id),NULL FROM fnd_company WHERE code IN ('04','004') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ehr_company WHERE TRIM(compCode)='004') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_company t WHERE TRIM()='004') ORDER BY code,source_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'DEPARTMENT' AS kind,d.depCode AS code, CASE WHEN d.depCode IN () THEN f.departmentName ELSE d.depName END AS name, CASE WHEN d.depCode IN () THEN CASE f.status WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 0 THEN 1 END ELSE COALESCE(CAST(d.isDisabled AS UNSIGNED),0) END AS status, CONCAT('',d.depID) AS source_id,TRIM(c.compCode) AS company_code, CASE WHEN d.depCode IN () THEN '160000' ELSE parent.depCode END AS parent_code, CASE WHEN d.depCode IN () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS historical, f.createTime AS create_time,f.updateTime AS update_time, CASE WHEN d.compID IS NOT NULL AND d.compID != 0 AND c.compID IS NULL THEN 'RAW_COMPANY_REFERENCE_MISSING' WHEN d.adminID IS NOT NULL AND d.adminID != 0 AND parent.depID IS NULL THEN 'RAW_PARENT_REFERENCE_MISSING' WHEN d.depCode IN () AND f.id IS NULL THEN 'FND_HISTORY_REQUIRED' WHEN d.depCode IN () AND d.depCode NOT IN () AND parent.depCode IS NULL THEN 'COMPLETION_PARENT_MISSING' END AS source_issue, CASE WHEN d.depCode IN () AND d.director IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('P01_DIRECTOR_ASSOCIATION_PENDING:',d.depCode) END AS warning FROM ehr_department d LEFT JOIN ehr_company c ON c.compID=d.compID AND d.compID != 0 LEFT JOIN ehr_department parent ON parent.depID=d.adminID AND d.adminID != 0 LEFT JOIN fnd_department f ON f.departmentNum=d.depCode AND d.depCode IN () WHERE (d.depGrade <= '2' AND LENGTH(d.depCode)=6) OR d.depCode IN () UNION ALL SELECT 'DEPARTMENT',f.departmentNum,f.departmentName, CASE WHEN f.departmentNum IN ('160700002','310500001') THEN CAST(e.isDisabled AS UNSIGNED) ELSE CASE f.status WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 0 THEN 1 END END, CONCAT('',f.id),NULL, CASE WHEN f.departmentNum LIKE '16%' THEN '160000' WHEN f.departmentNum LIKE '31%' THEN '310000' WHEN f.departmentNum='280700' THEN '280000' END, 1,f.createTime,f.updateTime, CASE WHEN f.departmentNum IN ('160700002','310500001') AND e.depID IS NULL THEN 'RAW_DEPARTMENT_REFERENCE_MISSING' END, NULL FROM fnd_department f LEFT JOIN ehr_department e ON e.depCode=f.departmentNum AND f.departmentNum IN ('160700002','310500001') WHERE f.departmentNum IN () AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ehr_department d WHERE d.depCode=f.departmentNum AND ((d.depGrade <= '2' AND LENGTH(d.depCode)=6) OR d.depCode IN ())) ORDER BY code,source_id LIMIT #{limit}
